description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent.

In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in both staff development and maintaining rigorous infection prevention and control standards. You will ensure our team is well-trained and equipped, while also safeguarding the health and safety of our residents and staff through effective infection control protocols.

This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled nurse to make a significant impact within a supportive and dynamic environment. If you are passionate about quality care and staff education, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in infection prevention and control
Experience in staff development or education
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to infection control and long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
